agent_control.content: Request state must not be shared between concurrent agents because doing so creates race conditions where one agent's mutations can overwrite or corrupt another's in-flight data, leading to nondeterministic behavior and hard-to-debug failures. It also violates isolation boundaries, risking cross-request data leakage and security vulnerabilities, since each agent's request carries its own context, session, and authorization that must remain private to that single execution.
